method: The existing offline rules are evaluated as binary positive (SUSPICIOUS/FRAUD or a structural indicator) versus negative. Reputation providers are not called.

datasets.source: Almeida, T. & Hidalgo, J. (2011), SMS Spam Collection, UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.collection_date: Underlying message collection dates are not fully specified by UCI; donated to UCI on 2012-06-21.
datasets.preprocessing: Read the original tab-separated label and message; map ham to negative and spam to positive. No text normalization beyond the detector own NFKC/casefold processing. Spam is only a broad proxy, not equivalent to fraud or UPI scams.

datasets.source: Project-authored scenario fixtures; no real URLs or real payment details
datasets.preprocessing: No external collection; URLs use .test domains and documentation-only IP addresses.

datasets.source: Mohammad, R. & McCluskey, L. (2012), Phishing Websites, UCI Machine Learning Repository
datasets.collection_date: Donated to UCI on 2015-03-25; upstream records vary.
datasets.preprocessing: Reviewed but excluded from raw-URL metrics: its 30 columns are engineered features, not URL strings, so they cannot exercise this URL parser.
